name: Flavolist
author: freddiesoftware

sections.description:
FLAVOLIST is the specialized WooCommerce plugin built for food businesses (caterers, bakeries, butchers, fishmongers, and food shops). It turns online order chaos into a streamlined kitchen workflow by adding business-specific tools for pickup and delivery scheduling, custom checkout fields, order dashboards, and calendar views.

Whether you sell daily baked goods, gourmet platters, cheese boards, sushi, or seasonal holiday menus, Flavolist gives you complete control over your pickup windows and backend organization.

Free Features Included:

  • Pickup & Delivery Control: set up custom pickup windows, timeslots, and lead times.
  • Holiday & Closing Dates: configure up to 2 closing dates/holidays for your store.
  • Order Calendar & Dashboard: keep a clear visual overview of all incoming orders by date and pickup slot.
  • Core Order Overview: view and manage your daily order flow directly inside WooCommerce.
  • Single Location Support: ideal for single-store food businesses getting started with online orders.

Need Advanced Kitchen Automation? We are working on Flavolist Pro for the full export engine: ingredients lists, sub-item breakdowns, packing slips, preparation labels, box labels, Excel/pivot exports, and multi-location support for agencies and growing businesses.

External services

This plugin runs entirely on your local WordPress installation and does not connect to, send data to, or load scripts from third-party external services.

Compatibility

  • The pickup and delivery settings support both the Classic Checkout and the WooCommerce Checkout Block.
  • Checkout Field Editor fields are designed for the Classic Checkout, they may not appear when a store uses the WooCommerce Checkout Block.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) is not currently supported.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open the FLAVOLIST admin menu to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. This plugin is built to run with WooCommerce active.

Where can I configure pickup and delivery settings?

Go to the FLAVOLIST settings pages in wp-admin.
